# Rift Dive

> An unofficial, fan-made daily League of Legends trivia game.

Play: https://riftdive.gg/
Source: https://github.com/OWNER/riftdive

Seven prompts, 25 seconds each. Rarer answers score up to 100 points; each point is 10 metres of depth. Free to play, no accounts.

Not endorsed by Riot Games. League of Legends is a trademark of Riot Games, Inc.
